design.balance: complete 16 x 2 crossing; exactly one fresh complete pair per cell
design.selection: all domains, exact surfaces, weights, controls, and tokenizer identities frozen before tokenizer exposure

estimand.population: 32 fresh plural-subject operational statements, 16 distributive and 16 collective
estimand.baseline: short careful English explicitly carrying separate-per-member or one-joint-instance semantics
estimand.aggregation: equal weight across all 32 cells within encoding; headline is the least-favourable maximum encoding mean

manifest.evidentiary_limit: token price only; no comprehension, fidelity, adoption, or instance-count recovery inference

source.input_relation: all 64 complete surfaces are absent from 5 retrievable prior pair manifests (108 prior surfaces)
source.redesign_note: Wire-only repair after current register refused the legacy @vocab tokenizer suffix: remove @vocab from both encoding identities. All 32 item surfaces, weights, encodings, fingerprints, results, and source target are unchanged. The predecessor attempt proves item freeze before tokenizer exposure; this successor was minted after the roster-validation refusal and result computation and must not be described as a fully pre-spend preregistration.

manifest.method: Freeze all 32 pairs before importing tiktoken. After mint, verify deterministic vocabulary fingerprints, encode each complete sentence with ordinary encoding and no special tokens, and compute Ainglish tokens minus English tokens. Report every per-pair delta, both 16-cell polarity means, each encoding mean, and the least-favourable maximum encoding mean regardless of sign. The predecessor manifest froze these exact items before exposure; the successor changes only the wire roster strings and openly records that its mint followed result computation.
